name: codex-coprocessor
description: Claude Code + Codex co-processing toolkit: skills that offload token-heavy work to the Codex CLI so only distilled results reach Claude.

plugins.name: codex-coprocessor
plugins.description: Context firewall (codex-recon), parallel map-reduce (codex-fanout), and output triage (codex-triage): three skills that route raw bytes to Codex and return only the distilled result.

plugins.name: delegate-to-codex
plugins.description: Teaches Claude when and how to offload work to the Codex CLI — heavy-token tasks plus capabilities Claude lacks (images, Office files, browser, Google/GitHub/Gmail).

plugins.name: consilium
plugins.description: Structured debate loop between Claude Code and Codex on a topic, refereed by an independent judge, until they converge on one actionable decision.
